France Draws with Italy in Zidane's Home Debut

Zinedine Zidane made his home debut as the new French national team manager in a match against Italy at the Stade de France. Despite a "splendid free kick" by Michael Olise, France drew with Italy. The match also saw Robert Lewandowski and Kevin De Bruyne perform well in the Nations League, while Edin Džeko played his final international game.
